creationInfo.comment: Production dependency graph for the vendored engine, OpenAqua-derived brand assets and compatibility metadata, plus Electron and self-hosted font components shipped by the desktop application.

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/agent-core-v2
packages.description: The unified agent engine for Kimi (v2 — DI Scope architecture)

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/kimi-code-oauth
packages.description: Kimi OAuth toolkit for managed Kimi Code authentication

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/kimi-code-sdk
packages.description: TypeScript SDK for the Kimi Code Agent

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/kimi-telemetry
packages.description: Shared telemetry infrastructure for Kimi Code

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/klient
packages.description: Kimi client SDK — contract-driven facade over agent-core-v2, routable over ipc or in-memory transports.

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/minidb
packages.description: A pure-Node.js embedded key-value database mixing Redis-style in-memory KV with SQLite-style durable persistence (WAL + snapshot).

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/remote-control
packages.description: Kimi Remote Control tunnel client: registers this machine with the relay and forwards HTTP/WebSocket traffic to the local server.

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/transcript
packages.description: Isomorphic transcript rendering data layer: agent-granular L1 store, idempotent L2 operations, granularity-gated L3 subscriptions, framework-free L4 view registry.

packages.name: @moonshot-ai/tree-sitter-bash
packages.description: A pure-TypeScript bash parser producing a syntax tree whose named node types match tree-sitter-bash one-to-one.

packages.name: OpenAqua
packages.comment: External backend compatibility target; the desktop package includes OpenAqua-derived brand assets but not the OpenAqua Python source or dataset.
